name: _media.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  home-mosaic/_media.scss — the card cover area: media wrapper, image,
//  hover title overlay gradient, and the cqw-responsive title text.
//  Imported by home-mosaic.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// height is set inline by JS — this block only handles visuals
.home-mosaic-media {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: inherit;
  overflow: hidden;
  // transition on height so the image area animates when card expands/collapses
  transition: height 0.52s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  transition: height 0.52s $ease-spring;
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    transition: none;
  }
}

// Card image — three-layer progressive stack, all painting the same
// absolute box so no tier swap can ever move layout:
//   --placeholder : intrinsic-size SVG data-URI — the painted floor
//   --thumb       : kodak LQIP paints first (baked bucket blur + slight
//                   zoom to hide blur-edge bleed)
//   --high        : quality ladder stacked over it, fading in once
//                   coverLadderStep publishes --loaded on `load`
.home-mosaic-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
  display: block;
  border-radius: inherit;
  transition: transform 0.48s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  transition: transform 0.48s $ease-spring;

  &--placeholder,
  &--thumb {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
  }

  &--thumb {
    filter: blur(var(--space-sm));
    transform: scale(1.05);
  }

  &--high {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    transition:
      transform 0.48s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 0.48s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    transition:
      transform 0.48s $ease-spring,
      opacity 0.48s $ease-spring;

    &.home-mosaic-img--loaded {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }
}

// Gradient overlay + title shown on hover.
.home-mosaic-title-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-lg);
  background: linear-gradient(
    to top,
    rgba($color-black, 0.88) 0%,
    rgba($color-black, 0.12) 55%,
    transparent 100%
  );
}

// Card title text inside the overlay.
.home-mosaic-title {
  @extend %TTL_SM;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 100;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--color-white-raw);
  text-shadow: 0 var(--space-2xs) var(--space-md) rgba($color-black, 0.8);
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--space-md); // fallback: Safari < 16 / iOS < 16 (no container query support)
  font-size: clamp(var(--space-md), 5cqw, var(--space-lg));

  .home-mosaic-item--featured & {
    font-size: var(--space-xl); // fallback: Safari < 16 / iOS < 16
    font-size: clamp(var(--space-md), 5.5cqw, var(--space-xl));
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  }
}
